finding.summary: When head_id not in self.best_pattern: When the per-layer pattern file (`config_path`) is missing, unreadable, or has fewer entries than `self.layer_idx`, `init_minference_parameters` sets `self.best_pattern = {}` and every head silently falls back to the hard-coded tuple `("vertical_and_slash", 1000, 6096, 1)` — i.e. vertical=1000, slash=6096 regardless of the actual head. The `ty` element is ...
finding.review_note: blind review by an LLM subagent (round 3), not human: Heads missing from the pattern config (or a missing/empty config_path) silently get a fixed default vertical_and_slash (1000, 6096) pattern; the 'whole sequence' claim only holds for q_len <= 6096.

analysis.reasoning: Line 430 directly confirms that a missing head_id falls back to ("vertical_and_slash", 1000, 6096, 1).
